readiness.reason: Static review verified credible defects on the playlist load path (F-001: e.status undefined, empty day marked saved) and auth refresh path (F-002), which can overwrite or drop on-air state. No runtime, browser or integration evidence exists, so the frontend cannot be called release-ready from static review alone.

F-001.reason: stores/playlist.ts:83 reads e.status, but AuthFetchError (composables/authFetch.ts:9-16) has only response and data, so the error branch never runs and markSaved() still executes.

F-002.reason: stores/auth.ts:236-238 and :248 call removeToken() on any non-ok refresh response or thrown error, including 5xx and network failures, so the logout is not limited to 401.

F-003.reason: GenericModal.vue:60-64 handles Escape, but ScheduleDialog and LiveDialog have no Escape or focus handling; no component traps or restores focus. Blocker status is a separate question outside my vote.

F-004.reason: App.vue:83-88 sets htmlAttrs lang from locale via useHead, so <html lang> updates at runtime. index.html:2 is only the pre-hydration default. Residual non-canonical casing is minor and outside my scope.

F-005.reason: SettingsGeneral.vue:314, UserEditor.vue:98, SettingsIngest.vue:240 and PlaylistPanel.vue:1236 hard-code text-[#ff9da0]; on the light theme base-100 (#ffffff) the contrast is about 1.98:1.

F-006.reason: SettingsBreaks.vue:112 and :128 give the error and mismatch-warning states the same text-accent-text style, and :118 uses the on-air red for the error dot.

F-007.reason: Auth store and SSE composable are outside my visual scope; not checked.
